lines.text: [curious] Who does A I recommend? [pause] You... or your competitors?
[curious] Same question... every assistant. [pause] And every single answer? Someone else.
[confident] So we built an AI to make sure you get cited. It handles your website... your content... your backlinks.
It writes PR articles and gets them published. Plans a month of content — and pushes it straight to your site.
[satisfied] A month of content — on the calendar. Ready to be cited.
Every article is checked, scored... and set to publish itself.
[confident] And your PR doesn't wait for journalists. It goes out to three hundred plus news sources. [satisfied] Automatically.
[confident] So the next time someone asks... [pause] it's you they cite.
